news.headline: Nektar R&D Chief Jonathan Zalevsky sells 186 shares to cover RSU tax withholding
news.summary: A routine, non-discretionary Form 4 sale of $13,388 in stock (186 shares at ~$71.98) by Chief R&D Officer Jonathan Zalevsky tied to RSU vesting tax obligations -- minor, but the most recent SEC-filed insider transaction on record.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity reiterates Buy on Nektar, keeps $153 price target after Q2 print
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity analyst Edward Nash reiterated his Buy rating and $153 price target on NKTR following the Q2 2026 report, citing the strong cash position and continued rezpegaldesleukin progress; other sell-side analysts also reaffirmed bullish stances with targets as high as $185.

news.headline: Piper Sandler reiterates Overweight/Buy rating on Nektar Therapeutics
news.summary: Piper Sandler reaffirmed its Overweight (Buy) rating on NKTR in the days following the Q2 2026 earnings release, one of several brokerages defending bullish targets on the stock.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics announces second quarter 2026 financial results
news.summary: Nektar reported a Q2 net loss of $40.6M ($1.23/share, beating consensus) on $10.1M revenue, with cash and investments of $1.023B (up from $245.8M at year-end 2025) funding a runway into Q3 2028; management confirmed the Phase 3 ZENITH-AD program (topline mid-2028, BLA 2029) and plans to start a single registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study in early 2027 -- shares slipped after hours despite the EPS beat.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity initiates coverage on Nektar Therapeutics with Buy rating, $153 price target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity began coverage of NKTR with a Buy rating and $153 target, adding a new bullish voice on rezpegaldesleukin's pivotal-stage prospects just after the ZENITH-AD Phase 3 launch.

news.headline: Nektar announces start of Phase 3 ZENITH-AD program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in two global, 510-patient registrational trials (ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2) evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, the company's first Phase 3 program and a key value-inflection milestone.

catalysts.label: ZENITH-AD Phase 3 topline data (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the global ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 registrational trials of rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, which started dosing in July 2026, expected mid-2028.

catalysts.label: Planned BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Company-stated target for first BLA filing, contingent on positive ZENITH-AD Phase 3 results.

catalysts.label: Initiation of ZENITH-AA Phase 3 study (alopecia areata)
catalysts.detail: Single registrational Phase 3 study in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, following an FDA end-of-Phase-2 meeting; data expected second half of 2029.

catalysts.label: Initial data from TrialNet Phase 2 study in new-onset Type 1 diabetes
catalysts.detail: Investigator-led (TrialNet) Phase 2 study of rezpegaldesleukin in ~70 patients with new-onset stage 3 T1D.

catalysts.label: Preclinical data presentation for NKTR-0165 (TNFR2 agonist antibody)
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to present preclinical data on its TNFR2 program (targeting MS, vitiligo, ulcerative colitis) at a scientific conference; first-in-human dosing also targeted for 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly financial results; exact date not yet announced by the company.

catalysts.label: Cash runway
catalysts.detail: Company guides to ending 2026 with ~$815-840M in cash and investments, extending runway past the mid-2028 Phase 3 AD readout.

pulse: Nektar enters the back half of 2026 fully funded (over $1B cash) and firmly in pivotal-stage execution mode: the Phase 3 ZENITH-AD atopic dermatitis trials began dosing in July, and a single registrational alopecia areata study is now slated for early 2027, pushing the earliest BLA filing out to 2029. Q2 2026 results (reported August 13) beat on EPS but the stock dipped after hours, even as sell-side analysts (Canaccord Genuity, Piper Sandler, and others) reiterated Buy ratings with price targets of $153-185 citing the cash runway and rezpeg's differentiated Treg mechanism. With no major new efficacy data expected until mid-2028, near-term catalysts are thin, and coverage has shifted to financing, analyst positioning, and routine insider filings rather than clinical readouts.
